newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 830 mln levs 6-mth, coupon T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 830 mln levs 6-mth, coupon T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry placed a special issue of six-month, floater coupon T-bills worth 830 million levs and yielding 117.72 percent to maturity, the central bank said.
The coupon was set equal to the central bank's main interest rate for the period to maturity. The main rate now is 18 percent monthly or 216 percent annually.
In line with its usual practice the central bank did not say with which financial intitution or institutions the issue was placed on Thursday.
Details of issue follow. Price is in percent of par.
